title: DocX root configuration ledger
description: Root docx.json declaring global metadata invariants and per-directory overrides that source files inherit via @docref. See references/docx-spec.md section 6.

version.description: DocX spec version this config targets.

profile.description: Enforcement profile. 'vibe' = Core-only and docslim caps come only from this file (per-function @docslim overrides are ignored). 'default' honors per-function overrides. Self-declares the profile so the CLI flag isn't needed.

include.description: Optional glob allow-list (relative to the scanned root). If set, inventory/docs only consider files matching one of these — apply DocX to your subtree, not an upstream package. Supports * and **.

exclude.description: Optional glob deny-list (relative to the scanned root), on top of the always-skipped node_modules/.git/dist/vendor.

global_invariants.description: System-wide defaults inherited by every file unless overridden.

directory_overrides.description: Glob-keyed overrides. Keys are paths relative to the repo root and may end in a wildcard, e.g. 'src/adapters/*'. More specific (longer) matches win.

tokenBlock.description: A DocX token's inherited key/value payload. Keys mirror the token's inline attributes.

allowed_imports.description: docdeps whitelist inherited by files under scope.
